title: Circuit mechanisms for disentangled representations and generalization in the hippocampus
title_zh: 海马体中解耦表示与概括的电路机制
abstract: Understanding how the heterogeneous activity patterns of individual neurons give rise to coherent population dynamics and cognition is a central challenge in neuroscience. In the hippocampus, neurons are tuned to spatial location, yet their activity is also modulated by multiple external and internal variables and appears to drift randomly over time, making it difficult to link hippocampal computations to behavior. By analyzing hippocampal population dynamics in behaving mice, we reveal a structured organization underlying the diversity of single-neuron responses—the hippocampus encodes different aspects of experience as disentangled variables represented in the co-activity dynamics of cell assemblies. The temporal and contextual components of these representations are governed by local inhibitory interactions and input-driven cell–assembly dynamics, respectively. Our findings reveal the circuit basis of disentangled hippocampal representations, offering a unifying geometric principle of population coding that supports flexible memory representations and enables rapid generalization of prior knowledge to new situations. The hippocampus encodes different aspects of experience as disentangled variables, enabling flexible recombination and generalization to new situations. This code is supported by the geometry of population dynamics and cell–assembly interactions.
abstract_zh: 理解个体神经元异质性的活动模式如何产生协调的群体动力学和认知，是神经科学的核心挑战。在海马体中，神经元对空间位置有选择性，但其活动也受多种外部和内部变量的调制，且随时间随机漂移，这使得将海马计算与行为联系起来变得困难。通过分析行为小鼠的海马群体动力学，我们揭示了单个神经元反应多样性背后的有组织结构——海马体将经验的不同方面作为解耦变量，以细胞组的协同活动动力学进行编码。这些表示的时间和语境成分分别由局部抑制相互作用和驱动的细胞组动力学支撑。我们的研究揭示了解耦海马表示的电路基础，为支持灵活记忆表示和实现对新情境快速概括的先验知识的群体编码提供了统一的几何原理。海马体将经验的不同方面作为解耦变量，以实现灵活的重组和对新情境的概括。该编码由群体动力学的几何结构和细胞组相互作用所支撑。
